SMTO-SCH-0014 — SMTO couldn't start this schedule right now

GUID: 328a71c6-4e35-4fe0-93b2-785dbf2e0b3c
Slug: schedule-launcher-unavailable
Domain: SCH · Subsystem: sch

What happened

  • The Agent tried to run a saved schedule right away, but the part of SMTO that starts scheduled runs wasn't available to it. No run was started.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Schedules and find this schedule. Check its Last run line and whether its button says Already running. No run was started by this error, so checking first makes sure you don't end up with two runs of the same work.
  2. If nothing is running, select Run now on the schedule's card yourself. The Schedules page starts the run directly, without needing the Agent's link to the scheduling service.
  3. If Run now also fails, restart SMTO the way you normally do, wait for the startup screen to reach Ready, then try Run now once more. The service that starts scheduled runs is set up when SMTO starts, so a clean start usually brings it back.

What success looks like

  • The schedule's button changes to Already running, or a new time appears under Last run.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO. Don't delete the schedule or its history to get past this; the problem is in how the server started, not in the schedule.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Schedule launcher is not configured.

What this means

  • Manual schedule trigger has no callable launch implementation configured on the management service. Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.

Why this can happen

  • Manual schedule trigger has no callable launch implementation configured on the management service.

How to diagnose it

  • Check Controller launcher/service wiring before editing the task's timing.

How to fix it

  • The schedule run-now path found no callable launch function: skills/schedule/availability.schedule_trigger rejects an execution context whose schedule_service has no launch, and ScheduleManagementService.trigger raises the same error when built without one (the fallback in skills/schedule/tools.py). The launcher is normally attached by initialize_services in api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/services.py and passed to Agent and Workflow runs as schedule_service; check the Server log for services startup errors, and restart the Server through the supported startup if the Schedules page's Run now also fails.
  • Restore the scheduler launcher service and its configured runtime dependency before enabling scheduled work.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported launcher is available and preserves the schedule's captured authority.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
